Alyssa —

Appreciate the detailed numbers; that helps. Attached is a short worksheet (RI_cost_model_PrismHealth_v1.xlsx) with three scenarios mapped to the workloads you described:

1) Hosted API (per-token):
   - Best for low ops overhead and bursty/variable demand.
   - Ballpark: $0.0009 / token on average across mixed models (we modeled mixing base-replica and optimi-quant). Monthly ≈ $Xk (see sheet).

2) Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity):
   - Predictable throughput, lower unit cost for sustained high throughput. Requires a monthly commit (typical 12m).
   - Ballpark: commit for equivalent steady-state yielding ~30–40% lower unit cost vs hosted in steady scenarios. Upfront commit depends on slot size.

3) Private VPC / On-prem:
   - Fits PHI/regulatory needs with customer-managed network and KMS/HSM integration. One-time infra/setup + support subscription. Break-even typically 12–18 months vs hosted depending on utilization.

Recommendation by workload:
- Chat (low-latency, high-volume, some PHI): Dedicated with KMS integration in Private lane for PHI traffic (hybrid routing) — combine dedicated pools for non-PHI chat and private VPC endpoints for PHI.
- Long-form batch jobs: Hosted API for peak elasticity or Dedicated for sustained nightly throughput (if cost-sensitive).

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll send the worksheet + a short mutual action plan with recommended owner names and procurement asks.
- Please confirm whether your security team needs an on-prem proof of concept or if SOC2 + KMS in VPC satisfies the control set.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Alyssa —

Attached an updated tab in the worksheet with the exact line item you requested:

- Dedicated baseline (smallest pool we recommend): 2x A100-equivalent slots (autoscale cushion) — committed monthly: $28,000 (12m term assumed).
- Equivalent hosted per-token estimate for the month (2M chat turns + 150k long-form as you provided): $41,500.
- Estimated blended unit delta: ~32% cost savings on dedicated vs hosted at steady utilization.

Notes and caveats:
- If you expect frequent 3x spikes, hosted is more attractive for peak handling. We modeled burst absorb with a 20% burst buffer on the Dedicated plan; reducing SLA for bursts lowers committed spend.
- Private VPC one-time setup: $95,000 (includes architecture, network integration, KMS integration), monthly support: $6,500. Break-even ~14 months at your steady numbers if PHI traffic stays at ~10% of overall.

I’ve also added an architecture sketch and a KMS keyflow summary in the shared link. If procurement is ready, we can turn these numbers into a term sheet and draft SOW.

Best,
Markus
